identity.name: Llama-3.2-3B
identity.summary: A multilingual generative language model in the Llama 3.2 collection, available in pretrained and instruction-tuned variants.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card reports only benchmark outperformance and gated access, with no documentation of design, training data, or evaluation process for this checkpoint.

possible_risks.description: Lack of data transparency might be due to insufficient documentation of training or tuning dataset details, including synthetic data generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not state training or tuning dataset details for Llama-3.2-3B, so data collection and composition are undocumented.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card describes a general multilingual text model with no stated intended-use or deployment scope, leaving downstream risk definitions open.
